metadata.condition_note: No action mask: all eight actions are allowed in every state; an infeasible action fails as an observed transition, costs its real time and the -0.01 step penalty, and changes nothing; state resource_v1
metadata.time_semantics: seconds measures task time after viewer readiness; elapsed_wall_seconds also includes world startup and viewer join
metadata.state_note: Compact partial observation; not a complete Minecraft MDP state
metadata.scripted_support: No action mask (all eight actions allowed; infeasible ones fail as observed transitions); bounded pathfinding, digging, pickup, recipes, placement, equip; bounded leaf clearing inside SEARCH (canopy descent beneath the feet, foliage escape beside the bot) and inside PLACE_TABLE (the same foliage escape when walled in with no placement surface); spectator camera only
metadata.recovery_helpers: When the bot stands on tree leaves, SEARCH may clear at most six leaf blocks directly beneath its feet, one at a time, only after scanning the column below for a landing within a recorded safe fall (no damage, or at most two points while health stays above ten, measured to the landing block's collision surface). Each cleared block, fall, and health change is saved in the transition's recovery field. Leaves broken by hand follow the vanilla loot table (about 5% sapling, 2% one or two sticks, 0.5% apple on oak and dark oak); pickups collected during a descent or an escape are listed in that record as items_picked_up and count in the inventory like any other natural item. When the bridge's movement rules report no legal move from the current cell, SEARCH (or PLACE_TABLE with no placement surface) may clear at most two leaf blocks beside the bot (feet and head height) towards a floored exit; never a log, dirt, or stone; recorded as leaf_escape (alone, or as the escape field of the descent record that led to it). Apart from these leaf blocks, no block is dug outside CHOP
metadata.reset: Each episode generates a separate new normal Survival world; bot has no operator permissions
metadata.seed_note: World seed controls terrain; server timing and spawn selection are not deterministic
